title: Mary did you know
lyrics_original: That your Baby Boy would one day walk on water?
That your Baby Boy would save our sons and daughters?
That your Baby Boy has come to make you new?
This Child that you delivered will soon deliver you
That your Baby Boy will give sight to a blind man?
That your Baby Boy will calm the storm with His hand?
That your Baby Boy has walked where angels trod?
When you kiss your little Baby you kissed the face of God?
Oh Mary did you know… Ooh Ooh Ooh
That your Baby Boy is Lord of all creation?
That your Baby Boy would one day rule the nations?
That your Baby Boy is heaven's perfect Lamb?
The sleeping Child you're holding is the great “I am”

bible_verses.telugu: ఇదిగో నీవు గర్భము ధరించి కుమారుని కని ఆయనకు యేసు అను పేరు పెట్టుదువు; ఆయన గొప్పవాడై సర్వోన్నతుని కుమా రుడనబడును; ప్రభువైన దేవుడు ఆయన తండ్రియైన దావీదు సింహాసనమును ఆయన కిచ్చును. ఆయన యాకోబు వంశస్థులను యుగయుగ ములు ఏలును; ఆయన రాజ్యము అంతములేనిదై యుండునని  ఆమెతో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus. He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David, and he will reign over Jacob’s descendants forever; his kingdom will never end.

bible_verses.telugu: రాత్రి నాలుగవ జామున ఆయన సము ద్రముమీద నడుచుచు వారియొద్దకు వచ్చెను ఆయన సముద్రముమీద నడుచుట శిష్యులు చూచి తొందరపడి, భూతమని చెప్పుకొని భయముచేత కేకలువేసిరి. వెంటనే యేసుధైర్యము తెచ్చుకొనుడి; నేనే, భయపడకుడనివారితో చెప్పగా
bible_verses.english: Shortly before dawn Jesus went out to them, walking on the lake. When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified. 'It’s a ghost,' they said, and cried out in fear. But Jesus immediately said to them: 'Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.'

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన ఇట్లు చెప్పి నేలమీద ఉమి్మవేసి, ఉమి్మతో బురదచేసి, వాని కన్నులమీద ఆ బురద పూసి నీవు సిలోయము కోనేటికి వెళ్లి అందులో కడుగు కొనుమని చెప్పెను. సిలోయమను మాటకు పంపబడిన వాడని అర్థము. వాడు వెళ్లి కడుగుకొని చూపు గలవాడై వచ్చెను.
bible_verses.english: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes. 'Go,' he told him, 'wash in the Pool of Siloam' (this word means 'Sent'). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I stand in wonder at the mystery of Your coming to earth as a humble child. Thank You for being the Savior who calms my storms, opens my eyes to Your truth, and delivers me from darkness. Help me to carry the same awe and trust that Mary held in her heart. Fill my soul with worship as I remember that the tiny baby of Bethlehem is the Almighty Lord of my life. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: As we contemplate Mary holding her newborn son, we are invited into awe at the profound mystery of the Incarnation. The fragile infant resting in a manger is the very Creator who would walk on water, heal the broken, and rescue humanity from sin. Mary’s story reminds us that God often enters our world in quiet, unexpected ways to work extraordinary salvation. As you sing, allow your heart to marvel at the depth of God’s love in sending Jesus to deliver us all.
